thought_leadership_themes: Family surnames as first names — modern way to honor passed loved ones (e.g., Taylor, Lawson, Sutton, Rooney, Murphy, Rhodes, Collins as gender-neutral first names)
The Bieber effect — celebrity naming choices driving Social Security ranking shifts (e.g., Jack rising after Jack Blues Bieber)
Naming as identity branding — the convergence of personal name strategy and brand strategy
Heritage meets identity — honoring lineage while creating distinctive identity
Name remorse and naming anxiety as legitimate emotional experiences requiring guidance
The growing market for bespoke naming services in tech-affluent cities (SF Bay Area as a hub)
